headline: Brokerages outline Q2 expectations and top stock picks
hook: Brokerages reveal top picks for Q2 earnings
summary: Brokerages have released their Q2 earnings outlook for major FMCG and beverage companies including Marico, Radico Khaitan, United Breweries, HUL, and Tata Consumer. Analysts are highlighting these firms as top buys ahead of the quarterly results season. The reports focus on margin trends, volume growth, and demand recovery across the consumer sector. Investors are evaluating these projections to gauge potential performance shifts in the upcoming earnings cycle.
whats_next: Q2 earnings announcements for the listed companies
why_it_matters: Brokerage outlooks may influence short-term stock price volatility before earnings.

headline: Brokerages reveal top BUYs and Q2 expectations for FMCG giants
hook: Brokerage picks ahead of quarterly results
summary: Analyst firms have released their top stock picks and quarterly earnings expectations for major fast-moving consumer goods companies including Marico, Radico Khaitan, United Breweries, HUL, and Tata Consumer Products. The reports outline projected growth and valuation metrics ahead of the upcoming Q2 financial disclosures. For Indian retail investors, these consensus estimates offer a benchmark to gauge sector performance and portfolio positioning.
whats_next: Q2 earnings announcements for FMCG companies
why_it_matters: FMCG stock expectations guide your quarterly sector allocations.
